competitors:Siemens Digital Industries.title: The Wendell Microgrid: A Blueprint for Resilient, Sustainable Manufacturing
competitors:Siemens Digital Industries.summary: Reliable energy is essential for manufacturing facilities. Through close collaboration between the Siemens Electrification & Automation manufacturing team in Wendell and Siemens Real Estate (SRE), an intelligent microgrid was developed that generates, stores, and manages energy on site. The microgrid can provide 100% of the electricity required to maintain industrial operations, allowing the facility to continue production even when the external grid is unavailable.
